steps.message: The comment says 10% off, so 95 is the bug; it should be 90.

arguments.command: sed -i 's|base \* 95 / 100|base * 90 / 100|' bin/price && bash tests/price_test.sh && echo ok

raw_arguments.command: sed -i 's|base \* 95 / 100|base * 90 / 100|' bin/price && bash tests/price_test.sh && echo ok

steps.message:
I fixed `bin/price`, and `tests/price_test.sh` now passes. The "tidy up" commit (3e703b3) had changed the member discount multiplier from 90 to 95, which gave 5% off instead of the documented 10%. I changed it back to `base * 90 / 100`.

I haven't committed the change or commented on issue #31.
